description: Replace the elements, data fields and/or label script of an existing design. Content is validated and auto-fixed (scripts are checked, never changed), then saved as a new version so the user keeps history and can revert. Uses no AI generation quota. Adding or changing a script needs Professional or higher; removing one (scripts: null) works on every plan; a linked copy cannot change the script it inherits.

$schema.description: Schema id. Use "https://label.cleverence.com/schema/label-design.v2.json" (or omit) when sending scripts; a v1 id with scripts is refused.

dataFields.description: Data fields (see create_design_from_json). Send them together with elements: a content update replaces both.

elements.description: Design elements (see create_design_from_json). Required whenever dataFields is sent. Omit both elements and dataFields to change only the script and keep the content as stored.

message.description: Version history message, e.g. "Widened the tracking barcode"

name.description: Rename the design at the same time

scripts.description: Label script (CLS/1). Omit to keep the stored script, null to remove it. See cleverence://skills/label-scripts.

name: update_design_content
title: Update Design Content
